patterns.note: The primary content display is a full-width, responsive masonry-style grid of portfolio images, maximizing visual impact and content density.
A highly distinctive, elegant serif font is used for the main name/logo, creating a strong brand identity, contrasted with a clean, understated sans-serif for all supporting text.
A dominant, warm off-white background (#fffbf4) provides a sophisticated and clean canvas, allowing the vibrant and diverse photography to stand out.
The main header dynamically shrinks and sticks to the top of the viewport upon scrolling, providing persistent branding and navigation.
A 'FILTER' button appears and remains sticky within the portfolio grid as the user scrolls, offering continuous interaction for content categorization.
Portfolio images are revealed into view as the user scrolls down the page, creating a continuous flow of content rather than appearing all at once.
The site is structured almost entirely as a continuous, scrollable grid of portfolio work, with minimal distinct content sections beyond the header and a subtle footer.

technique_notes: The header implements a scroll-triggered transformation, shrinking in height and fixing to the top of the viewport after a certain scroll threshold, maintaining a compact navigation.
Portfolio items are loaded and revealed into the viewport as the user scrolls, using a lazy-loading or scroll-triggered animation technique to manage performance and create a dynamic content flow.
A floating 'FILTER' button is positioned to appear and stick within the main content area once the user scrolls past the initial page fold, providing persistent access to content filtering.

design_tokens.type_scale: The main display name uses a very large, elegant serif (~4x body) for a strong brand statement, contrasted with small, understated sans-serif labels and a tiny tagline.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are used for most image containers and UI elements, with a subtle rounded corner on interactive elements like the 'FILTER' button.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy spacing around the initial header provides breathing room, transitioning to a balanced, tight grid for the portfolio images, maximizing content density.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its elegant, full-page masonry grid portfolio that serves as the primary content and navigation. The bold, large serif typography for the name, combined with the warm off-white background and vibrant photography, creates a sophisticated, art-gallery-like experience that prioritizes visual impact and a seamless browsing flow.
